{{Quote|Piracy is expected to be dealt with by the individuals traveling these space lanes. Normally, they don't cause too much trouble. But this one has become a problem. Not content with taking cargo, he has destroyed a number of transports in the last few weeks and shows no signs of stopping.|[[Belga Daeri]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BD">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Belga Daeri|Kashyyyk}}</ref>}}
The '''Asteroid Bandits''', also known as the '''Mining Pirates''', were a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] active in many different [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:DDC" /><ref name="SWG:CS" /><ref name="SWG:DS" /><ref name="SWG:ES" /> In space battles, they flew [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95-AF4 Headhunters]], [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]],<ref name="SWG:CS" /> [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]],<ref name="SWG:ES" /> and [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack crafts]].<ref name="SWG:DS" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a group of Mining Pirates led by [[Dorn Nareusu]] seriously disturbed the civilian traffic in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] by destroying numerous [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. After several weeks, [[Belga Daeri]], an official at the [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], placed a [[Death mark/Legends|bounty]] on Nareusu. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of pilots attacked Nareusu's cohorts in the Kashyyyk system to attract the pirate in the system.<ref name="SWG:DDC" /> Dorn Nareusu, piloting an [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter]], was killed in the ensuring fight.<ref name="SWG:DA">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=space|Dorn's arrival|Kashyyyk system}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Asteroid Bandits appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Asteroid Bandits were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] on [[May 5]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:CS" />
